jobs.title: SAP AI Transformation - Senior Consultant - SAP OTC
jobs.description:
Join Deloitte's SAP practice and build a career at the forefront of business transformation, where innovation, industry insight, and leading technology come together to solve complex challenges. You'll work with dynamic teams and leading organizations to modernize core processes, enable digital transformation, and help clients unlock lasting value through SAP\-enabled solutions.  

  

In this SAP AI Transformation role, you'll contribute to Agentic ERP transformations that help clients advance toward the autonomous enterprise. Combining SAP expertise with AI\-enabled delivery approaches, cross\-functional collaboration, and industry insight, you'll help address complex business challenges and create measurable client impact.  

  

Recruiting for this role ends on 01/15/2027\.  

  

**Work you'll do**  

  

As a Senior Consultant in Deloitte's SAP practice, with a focus on SAP Order to Cash, you will work side by side with functional and technical client team members to rapidly prototype and deliver high\-impact solutions that support Agentic ERP transformations. With Deloitte Ascend™, you'll leverage AI accelerators and SAP capabilities to help clients modernize business processes and advance toward the autonomous enterprise.  

  

This role requires a highly motivated professional who moves with speed and precision, builds practical solutions, and engages confidently with senior stakeholders and delivery teams to help generate measurable business impact.  

* Own assigned SAP Order to Cash workstreams, including work\-plan execution, dependencies, risks, issues, decisions, stakeholder coordination, and quality of deliverables.
* Lead and facilitate opportunity\-identification, fit\-to\-standard, autonomous solution\-design, and playback workshops with client stakeholders and technical teams.
* Translate commercial and Order to Cash improvement opportunities into SAP solutions and lead assigned functional design and configuration activities across the end\-to\-end Order to Cash process.
* Lead and coordinate commercial integration requirements across procurement, supply chain, accounting, tax, treasury, and reporting teams.
* Lead or oversee data migration, testing, defect resolution, cutover, deployment, hypercare, and stabilization activities.
* Assess Order to Cash processes and design AI\-enabled and automated improvements across order management, pricing, fulfillment, billing, cash application, dispute management, reporting, and process performance; use Deloitte Ascend™ accelerators where applicable, with human review and validation of AI\-generated outputs.
* Serve as a day\-to\-day client advisor by communicating progress, decisions, risks, and recommendations to business and senior client stakeholders.
* Coach junior team members, review work products, and contribute to proposals, estimates, reusable assets, and SAP practice development.

  

A successful candidate would possess these skills:  

* Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
* Effective written and verbal communication skills
* Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
* Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
* Ability to lead projects or workstreams
* Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast\-paced and dynamic environment
* Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
* Ability to meet deadlines
* Ability to provide clear guidance to others

  

**The team**  

  

Deloitte's SAP practice helps clients design, implement, and sustain SAP\-enabled transformations to enable an Autonomous Enterprise. Our teams combine industry knowledge, functional experience, and technology capabilities to support first\-time implementations, business\-led enhancements, and large\-scale SAP S/4HANA programs.  

  

Professionals in the practice work with leading organizations across industries to modernize operations, improve process performance, and unlock value through cloud, automation, analytics, artificial intelligence, and machine learning.  

  

**Qualifications**  

  

**Required:**  

* Bachelor's degree; or an associate degree and 6\+ years of SAP, enterprise resource planning (ERP), or consulting experience in lieu of a bachelor's degree.
* 5\+ years of experience in SAP consulting, enterprise resource planning (ERP) implementation, or SAP/ERP technology transformation in a consulting or industry environment.
* Experience supporting at least two full\-lifecycle SAP implementations from project initiation through go\-live and hypercare, with demonstrated ownership or leadership of an SAP Order to Cash workstream or workstream area on at least one implementation, and experience supporting an SAP S/4HANA implementation.
* 2\+ years of hands\-on functional configuration experience in at least one of the following: SAP Sales and Distribution (SD), or SAP Billing and Revenue Innovation Management (BRIM).
* Experience managing work plans, dependencies, risks, issues, decisions, deliverables, and team coordination.
* Experience collaborating directly with client stakeholders to gather and document business requirements and support solution design, configuration, testing, or deployment on at least one SAP implementation, transformation, or support project.
* Ability to travel up to 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.

* Experience supporting SAP cloud programs or SAP transformation programs deployed across multiple countries.

jobs.title: SAP FICO Subject Matter Expert
jobs.description:
**Key Responsibilities**

* **SME \& Leadership:** Serve as the primary SAP FICO functional SME supporting finance users, driving Center of Excellence (COE) practices, and guiding senior leadership on digital finance transformations.
* **Solution Architecture:** Translate complex business requirements into robust SAP S/4HANA\-enabled solutions and custom system designs.
* **Core FICO Configuration:** Manage configuration and support for Procure\-to\-Pay (P2P), Order\-to\-Cash (O2C), and Record\-to\-Report (R2R) cycles.
* **Operations \& Month\-End:** Oversee General Ledger, AP, AR, Asset Accounting, tax compliance (GST, WTH, E\-invoice), banking interfaces (EBRS, MT940\), and month\-end/year\-end closings.
* **Controlling (CO):** Drive Product Costing (CO\-PC), Profitability Analysis (CO\-PA), Cost Centre Accounting, and Material Ledger/Actual Costing.
* **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** Partner with teams managing MM, SD, PP, and PS modules, and manage RICEF objects for complex manufacturing scenarios.
* **Governance \& Support:** Provide L2/L3 support, troubleshoot complex business scenarios, ensure high system availability, and maintain compliance.

**Educational Qualifications**

* **Professional / Postgraduate:** Chartered Accountant (CA), Cost Accountant (CMA / ICWA), MBA (Finance), or Postgraduate Degree in Commerce.
* **Undergraduate:** Bachelor’s Degree in Commerce, Finance, Accounting, Information Technology, or a related discipline.

**Required Experience \& Competencies**

* **Total Experience:** 12 to 15 years in SAP FICO implementation, enhancement, and support.
* **Implementation Track Record:** Minimum 4–5 years of hands\-on, end\-to\-end SAP S/4HANA or SAP HANA implementations as an FICO consultant.
* **Industry Background:** Prior experience in manufacturing sectors (such as Cement, Steel, Automotive, or FMCG) is strongly preferred.
* **Deep Functional Skills:**
* *SAP FI:* New GL, AP, AR, Asset Accounting, GST/WTH/E\-invoicing, and Banking/EBRS interfaces.
* *SAP CO:* CO\-PC (Product Costing \& Material Ledger), CO\-PA (Profitability Analysis), and Cost Centre Accounting.
* *Technical:* Strong exposure to integration (MM, SD, PP, PS) and writing functional specs for RICEF objects.

**Preferred Certifications**

* SAP Certified Application Associate – Financial Accounting (FI) / Management Accounting (CO)
* SAP S/4HANA Financial Accounting Certification
* ITIL Foundation Certifica

Pay: ₹2,500,000\.00 \- ₹3,000,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: SAP BRIM - Senior Consultant
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced, passionate pioneer in technology who wants to work in a collaborative environment? As an experienced **SAP BRIM \- Senior Consultant, Managed Services** you will have the ability to share new ideas and collaborate on projects as a consultant without the extensive demands of travel. If so, consider an opportunity with Deloitte under our Project Delivery Talent Model. Project Delivery Model (PDM) is a talent model that is tailored specifically for long\-term, onsite client service delivery.  

  

**Work you'll do/Responsibilities**  

  

**Deloitte is implementing a new SAP BRIM instance in a client environment, with go\-live expected in the first week of December. The project is focused on preparing the platform and business processes for a successful launch. Go\-live activities include final readiness checks, coordination across delivery teams, and transition planning to support a stable rollout.**  

* Provide L2/L3 functional support for SAP BRIM (incidents, service requests, problems, changes) aligned to ITIL/AMS governance.
* Perform triage and root cause analysis for billing, charging, invoicing, subscription, and receivable\-related issues.
* Support and configure end\-to\-end BRIM processes:
* Primarily Convergent Mediation (CM) and usage data processing where applicable.
* Subscription Order Management (SOM) including subscription lifecycle management.
* Convergent Charging (CC) for usage\-based and recurring charging scenarios.
* Convergent Invoicing (CI) includes billable item processing, invoicing, and bill generation.
* Contract Accounting and Receivables Management (FI\-CA) includes collections, disputes, payment allocation, and account maintenance.
* Primary Skill set \- Convergent Mediation (CM) and usage data processing where applicable.
* Revenue and order\-to\-cash processing integration with SAP S/4HANA.
* Manage minor enhancements and configuration changes including pricing, charging plans, invoicing rules, business partner setup, account determination, and collections processes.
* Support monitoring and controls including billing jobs, invoice runs, charging processes, interface monitoring, reconciliation activities, and operational KPIs.
* Functional leadership from onshore. Lead a larger BRIM / SOM AMS team based in India
* Communicate regularly with Engagement Managers (Directors), project team members, and representatives from various functional and / or technical teams, including escalating any matters that require additional attention and consideration from engagement management.
* Independently and collaboratively lead client engagement workstreams focused on improvement, optimization, and transformation of processes including implementing leading practice workflows, addressing deficits in quality, and driving operational outcomes.

  

**The successful candidate would possess these skills:**  

* Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
* Effective written and verbal communication skills
* Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
* Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
* Ability to lead projects or workstreams
* Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast\-paced and dynamic environment
* Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
* Ability to meet deadlines
* Ability to provide clear guidance to others

  

**The Team**  

  

Our Deloitte Enterprise Performance team is at the forefront of enterprise technology, working across finance, supply chain, and IT operations to deliver holistic performance improvement and digital transformation. Join our team of strategic advisers and architects, differentiated by our industry depth to collaborate with leading solution providers and leverage your experience in strategy, process design, technology enablement, and operational services to enable heart\-of\-the\-business solutions.  

  

**Qualifications**  

  

**Required**  

* 7\+ years of experience working with SAP BRIM
* 7\+ years of experience providing functional support to SAP BRIM
* 7\+ years of experience integrating revenue into OTC processing with SAP S/4HANA
* Experience with onshore and managing offshore teams
* Bachelor's degree, preferably in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, or related IT discipline; or equivalent experience
* Limited immigration sponsorship may be available
* Ability to travel 10%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve

  

**Preferred**  

* Analytical/ Decision Making Responsibilities
* Analytical ability to manage multiple projects and prioritize tasks into manageable work products
* Can operate independently or with minimum supervision
* Excellent Written and Communication Skills
* Ability to deliver technical demonstrations

  

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $95,600 to $159,300\.  

  

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

jobs.title: SAP Delivery and Solution Architect (GTM) - Technology, Media & Entertainment (TME) Industry
jobs.description:
Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way you’d like, where you’ll be supported and inspired by a collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where you’ll be able to reimagine what’s possible. Join us and help the world’s leading organizations unlock the value of technology and build a more sustainable, more inclusive world.


**About the Job You're Considering**
------------------------------------

The SAP Technology, Media \& Entertainment (TME) Delivery \& Solutioning Architect (GTM) is a senior transformation leader responsible for shaping, selling, architecting, and delivering large\-scale SAP\-enabled business transformation programs for Technology, Media, and Entertainment clients. This role combines deep SAP expertise with industry\-specific knowledge across technology, software and digital services, media, entertainment, and content\-driven businesses to design end\-to\-end solutions that drive measurable business outcomes.

  

The architect serves as a trusted advisor to executive stakeholders and is accountable for developing solution strategies, leading complex pursuits, driving innovation, and ensuring successful delivery of enterprise transformation programs. The role plays a critical part in Capgemini’s Go\-to\-Market (GTM) strategy by creating compelling client value propositions, building reusable assets and accelerators, and contributing to thought leadership across the TME industry sector.

  

This role will help build the offering and drive growth through strategic pre\-sales activities, support Centers of Excellence, promote global alignment across regions, and maintain close alignment with client expectations through active involvement in transformation delivery engagements.

  

As Technology, Media \& Entertainment organizations continue to evolve toward digital, subscription, consumption\-based, and AI\-enabled business models, this role extends beyond traditional SAP transformation. The architect will help clients leverage SAP Business AI, Business Data Cloud, enterprise architecture, intelligent automation, and emerging agentic AI capabilities to modernize operating models, monetize products and services, improve customer and partner experiences, optimize enterprise operations, and advance their Autonomous Enterprise journey.

  

This position requires a strong balance of **TME industry expertise, business consulting, enterprise architecture, pre\-sales leadership, delivery governance, and AI\-enabled transformation capabilities** , while leveraging SAP innovations including S/4HANA, SAP Business AI, SAP BTP, Subscription Billing, BRIM, Customer Experience, Revenue Accounting and Reporting, Industry Cloud solutions, and emerging digital capabilities.


**Your Role**

jobs.description:
**Job Title: Enterprise Performance Engineering Architect/Lead (SAP \& CRM Integrations)**  

**Job ID: PA 814006**  

**Client:** Commonwealth of Pennsylvania – PA Turnpike Commission (PTC)  

  

**Work Arrangement:** Remote; onsite presence required approximately one week per month  

**Position Overview**  

The Pennsylvania Turnpike Commission is seeking an experienced **Performance Load Test Architect/Lead** to lead enterprise performance engineering and load testing for the **Journi program**. The resource will define performance testing strategies, establish performance standards, develop workload models, and ensure application scalability, stability, and production readiness across SAP, CRM, APIs, middleware, web portals, mobile applications, and integrated enterprise systems.  

**Required Skills**  

* **12\+ years** of overall IT experience.
* **8\+ years** of enterprise performance engineering and load testing experience.
* **5\+ years** leading enterprise performance testing initiatives.
* Expert\-level experience with **NeoLoad**.
* Strong experience with **SAP BRIM, SAP S/4HANA, SAP Convergent Mediation (CM), SAP Datasphere, CRM platforms, APIs, middleware, and enterprise integrations**.
* Experience designing production workload models using historical production metrics.
* Strong knowledge of **capacity planning, performance engineering, scalability architecture, stress testing, endurance testing, spike testing, and failover testing**.
* Experience with **API and middleware performance testing, batch processing optimization, cloud/hybrid infrastructure performance, monitoring, and diagnostics**.
* Bachelor's degree in **Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field**.

**Key Responsibilities**  

* Define and lead the overall **performance engineering strategy** for the Journi program.
* Establish enterprise performance testing standards, governance, methodologies, and best practices.
* Define **non\-functional requirements (NFRs), service\-level objectives (SLOs), service\-level agreements (SLAs), and performance acceptance criteria**.
* Lead performance planning for Solution Confirmation, PI Planning, SIT, UAT, Go\-Live, and Hypercare.
* Review solution architecture to identify scalability risks, performance bottlenecks, and infrastructure constraints.
* Lead performance testing across SAP applications, CRM platforms, APIs, middleware, batch processes, event\-driven integrations, customer portals, mobile applications, IVR, and chatbots.
* Define workload models for concurrent users, transaction volumes, billing cycles, payment processing, toll transactions, and customer service operations.
* Establish monitoring strategies across applications, databases, middleware, infrastructure, and cloud platforms.
* Conduct root\-cause analysis and recommend application tuning, database optimization, infrastructure scaling, and configuration improvements.
* Lead implementation and administration of **NeoLoad**, reusable scripting frameworks, and automated performance regression testing.
* Develop performance dashboards and executive reports, and communicate risks and mitigation strategies to leadership.
* Maintain technical documentation, test plans, scripts, diagrams, impact analyses, and lessons learned.

**Preferred Qualifications**  

* **NeoLoad certification**.
* **Azure or AWS cloud certifications**.
* Experience leading performance engineering for enterprise\-scale applications and complex integrations.
